# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents section 1

## Start with the incident record

Do not take the incident record at face value.

---

## Read the accident incident records and complete the accident description form
- Hazards
- Unsafe acts or conditions
- Contributing factors
- Type of accident
- Summary of witnesses’ statements
- Statements of injured worker and other injured parties
- Company equipment
- Company policies/guidelines
- OSHA regulations

---

## Include statements from the injured worker, witnesses, emergency room staff, and first aid provider

Get them ASAP

---

# Further reading

- [Workplace Accident Investigation and Analysis by Larry Slutsky.](working_for_safe_workplace_accidents_analysis_and
